text.description_html:
Falcon Y-series Dane Grade 2 Leverset

ADA compliant levers are solid pressure-cast zinc. Small 2-9/16" diameter roses are wrought brass installed over steel reinforcing plates. A spring loaded retainer secures levers.

Complies with ANSI/BHMA A156.4, Series 4000, Grade 2. UL listed latch.

Specifications: for Falcon Y-series Dane Leverset

  • Door Thickness: Adjustable for 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick.
  • Backsets: Adjustable 2-3/4" - 2-3/8"
  • Strike: 2-3/4" x 1-1/8" T-strike standard.
  • Latchbolt: 1/2" projection, UL listed.
  • Handing: Non-handed.
  • Trim: Dane Levers.
  • Dane Lever Projection: 2-7/16"
  • Dane Lever Length: 4-3/4"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-9/16"
  • Keyways: Optional Small format IC less core (no lock cylinder) or Falcon "G" with core (with lock cylinder).

Available Functions:

  • Passage (Hall or Closet)(ANSI# F75): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom)(ANSI# F76): For doors that could need locking.
  • Keyed Entry/Office (ANSI# F81): Deadlocking latch bolt operated by lever except when outside lever is locked by turn button inside. Inside lever always free. When outside lever is locked, latch bolt is operated by key in outside lever or by rotating inside lever. Turn button must be manually returned to the unlocked position to release outside lever. Lock may be locked or unlocked by key in cylinder outside.
  • Classroom (ANSI# F84): Deadlocking latch bolt operated by lever. Outside lever is locked by key in outside lever. Inside lever is always free and unlocked.
  • Storeroom (ANSI# F86): Deadlocking latch bolt operated by inside lever at all times. Rotating key in outside lever temporarily unlocks mechanism allowing lever to retract latch bolt. When key is removed, outside lever becomes rigid. Entry by key only. Inside lever always unlocked.
